hook: Qwaqwa has so much potential. A lack of technology shouldn't be what holds it back.
caption:
Why we started PrimeCode Solutions.

Qwaqwa has a lot of potential to grow. What puts a limit on it isn't the people or the ideas. It's that there isn't much technology here yet. Too many businesses still run on paper and memory: bookings, stock and payments kept in a notebook.

That's why we started PrimeCode: to bring digital transformation closer to home.

And who else would do it, if not people born and bred here?

What's the one thing you'd fix about your business online?
